page_title: CRY 3-2 WOL | Crystal Palace v Wolves 03/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+6' 3 - 2 It's in the back of the net! Pedro Neto puts the ball on a plate for Matheus Cunha (Wolves), who has an easy finish with a header into an empty net. The score is 3:2.
90+4' Crystal Palace take a short corner kick.
90+3' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) produces a good strike that sails to the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper shows great reflexes and dives to keep the effort from hitting the net.
90+2' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) sends a cross into the box, but Sam Johnstone comes off his line to gather the ball.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' A substitution has been made. Odsonne Edouard is replaced by Will Hughes (Crystal Palace).
89' Pedro Neto (Wolves) gets a shot from distance but fails to generate enough power to beat the goalkeeper.
87' A clever lofted pass finds Sasa Kalajdzic (Wolves) in space inside the box. He looks up and hits a precise shot towards goal, but Sam Johnstone is equal to it and makes an easy save.
87' Robert Jones has a clear sight and sees a foul from Boubacar Traore (Wolves).

84' 3 - 1 Jean-Philippe Mateta is in a good shooting position, but he sees his teammate and passes the ball to him. Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) takes it nicely and beats the goalkeeper with a precise shot into the bottom left corner to make the score 3:1.
82' Gary O'Neil decides to make a substitution. Rayan Ait Nouri will be replaced by Hugo Bueno (Wolves).
81' Today's match ends for Joao Gomes who will be replaced by Sasa Kalajdzic (Wolves).
78' 2 - 1 Goal! After receiving a sweet pass, Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) unleashes a shot straight into the bottom left corner. Good team effort!
77' Boubacar Traore (Wolves) makes a slide tackle, but referee Robert Jones blows for a foul. Crystal Palace earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
75' Close! Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post.
73' Chance! Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) gets to the rebound on the edge of the box and smashes the ball towards the right side of the goal, but Jose Ca is alert and makes a great save to deny him.
73' Substitution. Boubacar Traore (Wolves) replaces Fabio Silva.
72' Marc Guehi (Crystal Palace) jumps inside the box to meet the resulting set piece and aims a header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes and makes a superb save.
72' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) prepares to take a corner kick.
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) replaces Jeffrey Schlupp.
70' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
69' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
67' Jeffrey Schlupp (Crystal Palace) wins the ball near the penalty spot and unleashes a header towards the middle of the goal, but Jose Sa is alert and denies him.

65' 1 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Pedro Neto flights the free kick into the box, where Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) peels off his marker and heads straight into the top of the net from the edge of the six-yard box. He makes it 1:1.
64' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
63' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Mario Lemina (Wolves) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
60' Here comes a substitution. Pablo Sarabia is given a rest as he is replaced by Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves).
59' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.

56' 1 - 0 Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) meets a perfect cross from Tyrick Mitchell deep inside the box and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces an accurate strike inside the left post. It's 1:0.
55' Joao Gomes (Wolves) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Robert Jones had an easy-decision to make.
55' Wolves keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
52' It must be a yellow card. It is. Joel Ward (Crystal Palace) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
50' Rayan Ait Nouri (Wolves) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Robert Jones blows for a foul.
49' 41:59 – the latest ball possession ratio.
47' Foul! Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Joao Gomes (Wolves) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
44' Robert Jones blows the whistle, Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) is penalised for a foul.
43' The corner kick from Pedro Neto (Wolves) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
43' Pedro Neto (Wolves) unleashes a decent shot towards the roof of the net, but Sam Johnstone thwarts him with a nice save.

41' Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) doesn't hesitate and begins a run towards the opponent's goal. Defenders try to tackle him, but he manages to keep the ball at his feet and pulls the trigger in front of the goal. The strike, though, was not as successful as the solo run and the ball is easily stopped by the keeper.
41' Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
39' Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
38' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
36' The opposition give Joao Gomes (Wolves) far too much space and he has a go from long range, but the goal isn't threatened as the ball goes well wide of the left post.
35' Pedro Neto (Wolves) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
32' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
31' The ball rebounds out to Fabio Silva (Wolves) on the edge of the box. He immediately strikes for goal, but sends the ball high over the bar.
30' The players claim that Joachim Andersen (Crystal Palace) handled the ball and it seems they are right.
29' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
28' The free kick is taken by Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace), but ball is cleared.
27' Rayan Ait Nouri (Wolves) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.

26' What a chance that is! Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes high over the crossbar!
26' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) fires the resulting free kick on goal from a medium range, but sees his shot saved by the goalkeeper.
24' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Nelson Semedo (Wolves) was quite harsh and Robert Jones didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
23' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) takes the corner kick, but Jose Sa reads it well and stops the effort.
22' The ball is cleared after Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Crystal Palace force a corner. They send men into the box.

21' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
20' Cheick Doucoure (Crystal Palace) hits a rasping drive from inside the box after latching onto a lofted pass, but it's straight at Jose Sa and he makes a comfortable save.
19' Craig Dawson (Wolves) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
17' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
16' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
15' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
13' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Nelson Semedo (Wolves), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
11' Joao Gomes (Wolves) has the goal in his sights after a good run to the edge of the box, but his weak effort flies well wide of the right post.
9' Jeffrey Schlupp (Crystal Palace) is penalised for a foul. Robert Jones had a clear view and blows his whistle.
8' Fabio Silva (Wolves) gets on the end of a pass, but mishits his shot and sends it high over the bar.
8' Pedro Neto (Wolves) will deliver the corner kick.
7' Pedro Neto (Wolves) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. Wolves force their opponents to concede a corner.
6' Some neat passing and movement from Wolves as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
5' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
4' Joachim Andersen (Crystal Palace) sends a long ball in, but Jose Sa comfortably gathers the ball.
2' Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) brings an opponent down and Robert Jones interrupts the game.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Wolves will have the kick-off.
Robert Jones is the one to supervise the game today.
